clauses.clause_label: 公开说明—原始 license 或来源说明
clauses.scope_note: Applies only to a skill directory in this repository that contains its own original license or source notice; it does not state the terms of that separate notice.
clauses.condition_explanation: The compliance direction applies when the individual skill directory contains an original license or source notice.

clauses.clause_label: 公开说明—确认来源和许可边界
clauses.scope_note: Requests that users independently confirm the relevant skill’s provenance and licensing boundaries before commercial use, redistribution, or large-scale modification; it grants no permission for those activities.
clauses.condition_explanation: The confirmation request is triggered by any of commercial use, redistribution, or large-scale modification.

coverage_notes: The text describes a collection of skills and gives repository-level guidance; it does not supply a general software license or grant permissions to use, copy, modify, distribute, sublicense, or commercially exploit the repository contents.
Any license or source notice inside an individual skill is not supplied here; its terms cannot be reconstructed from this text.
The stated exclusions and retained directory structure describe the repository’s preparation, not obligations imposed on downstream users.
